newsitem.title: RUSSIA: PRESS DIGEST - IZVESTIA - RUSSIA - JUNE 25.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - IZVESTIA - RUSSIA - JUNE 25.

text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in the June 26 edition of Russia's Izvestia newspaper. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Powerful financial groups wage struggle for the control over the giant Krasnoyarsk aluminium smelter in Siberia.
- Russian Prime Minister Viktor Chernomyrdin, on a visit to China, will give his government's backing to large-scale contracts between the two countries.
- Russian law-and-order authorities, unable to send shrewd mafia bosses, red in tooth and claw, behind bars on charges of extorsion and murder, are hoping to pin them down on tax evasion.

- Authorities are worried that foreign companies, most likely winners in the forthcoming shares auction of the telecommunications giant Svyazinvest, might get too much control over the Russian telephone network.
- The Duma deputies go on holiday despite the fact that a number of burning laws they had to approve remain on the waiting list.
- Russian state archives urgently need better financing.
